suggestions.assertion: Tasks and their hints from page-content.md appear in the output
suggestions.reason: This is the most important finding of this eval round: the same baseline model correctly folded hints into accordion tabs for the investigate-duplicate-orders eval but silently dropped both hints here. That inconsistency - not an outright inability - is exactly the kind of gap a skill with an explicit, concrete mapping step should close. Worth watching in iteration 2 whether the skill keeps this at 2/2 across more evals.

eval_feedback.overall: Two real gaps versus the with_skill run: the naming-convention miss (expected, not a quality issue) and a genuine content-completeness miss (dropped hints) that the with_skill run avoided in both of its evals.
